transitions.operation_detail: In situ reverse transcription in a 96-well plate with one barcoded random-hexamer primer per well (barcode 1); ramped RT program 50-8-15-20-30-42-50 C; cells pooled, Tween-20 treated, washed and redistributed afterwards.

Round 2 barcode oligos pre-annealed to linker SB83 are ligated in situ to the 5' end of the barcoded cDNA by T4 ligase (30 min, 37 C); unreacted ends are then blocked with SB84/SB85 (30 min, 37 C) before pooling and redistribution.

Round 3 barcode/UMI oligos pre-annealed to linker SB80 are ligated in situ to the 5' end of the cDNA by T4 ligase (30 min, 37 C); reactions are blocked with SB81/SB82 and stopped with EDTA, then cells are pooled, washed, counted and aliquoted for lysis.

major_reagents.name: NEBNext Second Strand Synthesis Enzyme Mix

transitions.operation_detail: Cells are lysed with proteinase K in lysis-T at 55 C, cDNA is AMPure XP purified, and the second strand is synthesized for 2.5 h at 16 C with the NEBNext Second Strand Synthesis Module (RNase H/DNA polymerase I based); the double-stranded cDNA is bead purified.

Nextera XT tagmentation (25 uL TD, 5 uL ATM, 5 min at 55 C, neutralized with NT). Five product classes arise; only the fragment retaining the round 3 overhang at one end and a transposed s7-ME end at the other is amplifiable with the primer pair used, so the s5/s5, s7/s7, s5/s7 and s5-plus-barcode products are dead ends and are not modeled as separate states. An EZ-Tn5 alternative loaded with SB117 (/5Phos/CTGTCTCTTATACACATCT) and SB118 (GTCTCGTGGGCTCGGAGATGTGTATAAGAGACAG) is described in the protocol.

Single PCR (72 C gap fill, 95 C denaturation, ~8-16 cycles of 95/55/72 C, 72 C final extension) with the i50x P5/i5 primer annealing to the round 3 overhang and the N70x P7/i7 primer annealing to the transposed s7 end; AMPure XP 1x cleanup, Qubit and Bioanalyzer QC are folded into this transition.
